Suggest books on habit formation and beh.overall_notes: These recommendations balance canonical, well-established works (Atomic Habits, The Power of Habit) with rigorous academic and research texts (Cognitive Neuroscience, The Cognitive Neuroscience of Memory). The selection spans from accessible popular science to advanced neuroscience, allowing readers at different levels to find scientifically-backed information on habit formation and behavioral psychology. Excluded items were self-help titles lacking scientific grounding, tangential books on asset allocation or agriculture, clinical texts focused on disorder treatment rather than habit formation, and evidence-based practice guides focused on healthcare methodology rather than behavioral psychology itself.
